message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What You Need to Know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the 108‑card deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** (0–9) in four colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue).
• **Action cards**:
 - **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
 - **Reverse** – changes play direction.
 - **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
 - **Wild** – player chooses the next color.
 - **Wild Draw Four** – player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Playing a Turn** | 1. Look at the top card on the discard pile.
2. Play one card from your hand that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of that card.
3. If you can’t play, draw one card from the draw pile.
4. If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Rules** | • **UNO Call** – When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before your turn ends. If another player catches you not saying it, you must draw two penalty cards.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Can only be played if you have no other playable card. If challenged and you were wrong, you must draw four cards instead of the challenger drawing. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by opponents:
 - Number cards = face value.
 - Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
 - Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
• If the winner goes out with a **Wild Draw Four** in hand, they receive an extra 50‑point bonus. | | **Game Continuation** | After each round, reshuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. Continue playing rounds until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of colors** – If you’re low on a particular color, try to play it early to avoid drawing more cards later. 2. **Use action cards strategically** – Save a **Reverse** when you’re about to win to change the direction and give yourself a chance to finish. 3. **Watch opponents’ hands** – If you see someone with only one card, make sure they say “UNO” or risk a penalty. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
